from_credential: A.A. (any MDC Associate in Arts pathway)
notes: Statewide 2+2 agreement: the 60 credits of the MDC A.A. transfer as a block. Some A.S. degrees transfer to specific bachelor's degrees (Career Ladder agreements). Does NOT guarantee admission to a particular university or to limited/specialized access programs.
limited_access_not_guaranteed: Limited/specialized access programs at every university

from_credential: A.A. (any MDC Associate in Arts pathway)
notes: FIU's 2+2 pathway. Earn the A.A. at MDC within 3 years to get guaranteed admission to most FIU programs. MDC students apply after earning 12-30 college credits and must declare a major at MDC. Meet with an FIU Bridge Advisor every term. FIU publishes 2026-2027 MDC transfer guides per major at tts.fiu.edu/guides/pdf/MDC/.
limited_access_not_guaranteed: FIU Specialized Admissions programs — more competitive criteria, admission not guaranteed (team notes list Architecture and Nursing; confirm on FIU's Specialized Admissions list)

from_credential: A.A. (any MDC Associate in Arts pathway)
notes: Link2FAU: earn the A.A. at MDC, then guaranteed and priority admission to FAU if you meet FAU admission requirements.
limited_access_not_guaranteed: FAU limited access and restricted programs may require an additional admissions process

from_credential: A.A. (any MDC Associate in Arts pathway)
notes: MDC points A.A. students to UCF Transfer Connect. UCF lists program-to-program agreements with Miami Dade (e.g. A.A. to B.S. in Biology). Statewide 2+2 rules apply.
